name: end-subject-membership
note: Fourth fixture of the twin conformance corpus (2026-07-28). NEUTRAL GROUND: belongs to neither twin. Pins the 2026-07-20 ruling ('The End prehends the capture') where interval-occlusion.json could not: that fixture has NO edge whose subject is a designated End-pole, so it silently blessed a divergence for eight days. Membership/charge edges now run subject=End, object=event — physically out of the End, but the event is still BETWEEN once and end, so a backward walk from `end` must step through it. scher-core/src/lib.rs mirrored these into bwd_adj on the day of the ruling; scher/src/society.ts never received the step. The 'stray' rows are the fence against the lazy fix: mirroring EVERY subject into bwd_adj would swallow the graph, so an edge from an UNDESIGNATED node must not carry the walk. One fixture, one law — occlusion stays interval-occlusion.json's axis.
